events.detail_full_main: イベント開催に伴う交通規制の影響で、31日17:30頃〜20:30頃まで、駅前〜新川電停間の列車が運休となります。代行輸送を行います。

events.detail_full_en: Due to traffic restrictions related to an upcoming event, services between the station front and the Shinkawa tram stop will be suspended from approximately 17:30 to 20:30 on the 31st. Substitute transportation will be provided.
